title: Phase 10: Tests (~500 LOC)
description:
Entry: Phase 8 complete (can run in parallel with Phase 9).

Phase 10 completes the test suite by adding tests NOT already written as part of Phases 2-9 completion criteria. Each prior phase's completion criterion already specifies and runs its own targeted integration tests.

Phase 10 adds the remaining cross-phase and corner-case tests:
- Version-resilience suite: feed transcript JSONL with extra/unknown fields across all JSONL event types; confirm no panic, correct output
- Hook inheritance suite: verify user hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json fire alongside the relay hook (OQ-2 resolution validated end-to-end)
- All MEDIUM/LOW mock scenarios not covered by earlier phases (see Testing section of plan.md for full list)
- Conformance harness: run claude-print against a real claude binary in a sandboxed invocation and compare output format to claude -p reference

Complete when:
- cargo test passes with zero failures (all unit + integration tests)

Reference: docs/plan/plan.md § Phase 10

title: Phase 8: Emitter (~120 LOC)
description:
Entry: Phase 7 complete.

Implementation: src/emitter.rs
- Output format routing: text (plain string to stdout), json (JSON object with result/cost/session_id/claude_version), stream-json (forward raw JSONL lines as written)
- claude_version: read from child process version string captured at startup
- Error result objects: exit code mapping (0=success, 1=error, 2=no-response, 3=timeout, 4=input-error)
- stream-json: reader thread consuming JSONL transcript file via mpsc channel, forward each line to stdout as written

Complete when:
- All emitter unit tests pass (tests/emitter.rs)
- AS-1 (text output format) passes: response text emitted to stdout, exit 0
- AS-2 (json output format) passes: valid JSON object on stdout with result field
- stream-json output parses as valid JSONL (each line is valid JSON)

Reference: docs/plan/plan.md § Phase 8

title: Phase 9: NEEDLE Integration (~50 LOC + config)
description:
Entry: Phase 8 complete.

Deliverables:
1. claude-print.yaml — NEEDLE agent config for dispatching beads via claude-print instead of claude -p
   - input_method: stdin, output_transform: needle-transform-claude
   - invoke_template: claude-print --output-format json --model ${MODEL}
2. install.sh — download release binary from GitHub, install to ~/.local/bin/claude-print, verify --check
3. claude-print-ci WorkflowTemplate in jedarden/declarative-config (k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/)
   - verify step only (build-musl + github-release steps added in Phase 11)
   - delegates to rust-verify WorkflowTemplate
4. --check subcommand in src/main.rs or src/check.rs
   - openpty probe: confirm openpty syscall succeeds
   - mkfifo probe: confirm mkfifo in /home/coding/.tmp succeeds
   - optional mock_claude PTY round-trip (if mock_claude binary present in PATH)
   - exits 0 on success, prints diagnostic table

Complete when:
- bash -n install.sh passes (syntactically valid)
- Manually copying locally-built binary to ~/.local/bin/claude-print and running claude-print --check succeeds
- NEEDLE dispatches a test bead using claude-print.yaml; AS-3 passes
- README flags table matches claude-print --help output exactly (verified manually)

Reference: docs/plan/plan.md § Phase 9

title: Phase 11: CI (~YAML only)
description:
Entry: Phase 10 complete (and Phase 9 complete for install.sh e2e test).

Deliverables in jedarden/declarative-config (k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/claude-print-ci.yaml):
- Update claude-print-ci WorkflowTemplate stub (from Phase 9) with full steps:
  1. verify — delegates to rust-verify WorkflowTemplate (fmt + clippy + test + cargo audit)
  2. build-musl — cross-compile x86_64-unknown-linux-musl release binary
  3. build-mock-claude-musl — build test-fixtures/mock-claude/ as musl binary
  4. github-release — upload claude-print + mock_claude binaries + last-claude-version.txt artifact to GitHub Release
- Confirm cargo audit runs (either via rust-verify or as explicit step between verify and build-musl)
- install.sh end-to-end download test: download release artifact from GitHub Release URL, verify install.sh exits 0 and claude-print --check passes

Complete when:
- CI run on main branch produces release binary at expected GitHub Release URL
- last-claude-version.txt artifact present in release
- Binary passes claude-print --check (credential-free) via install.sh
- install.sh end-to-end download test passes (deferred from Phase 9)
- AS-1 verified manually before pushing release tag

Reference: docs/plan/plan.md § Phase 11

title: Phase 7: Transcript Reader (~180 LOC)
description:
Entry: Phase 6 complete. PO-5 acknowledged: retry loop (40×50ms) is the mitigation for Stop-before-JSONL races. Verify retry timing by running test_transcript_race with MOCK_DELAY_JSONL=100 and confirming exit 0.

Implementation: src/transcript.rs
- JSONL parse with lenient serde (unknown fields tolerated, unknown event types skipped)
- message.id dedup + usage-fingerprint fallback dedup for events without message.id
- Text extraction from assistant ContentBlock array (text type only)
- 40×50ms retry loop with Stop-payload fallback to last_assistant_message after exhausted
- Path derivation: strip leading /, replace / with -, append session_id from Stop payload

Complete when:
- All transcript unit tests pass (tests/transcript.rs)
- test_streaming_dedup_40_retries passes
- AS-6 (race scenario: Stop fires before JSONL flush) passes with MOCK_DELAY_JSONL=100

Reference: docs/plan/plan.md § Phase 7

title: Phase 6: Stop Poller (~80 LOC)
description:
Entry: Phase 5 complete. OQ-2 must be resolved (verify --setting-sources= suppresses standard sources; see PO-2 for fallback). OQ-4 (FIFO open race) validated by test.

Implementation: poller.rs (or extend event_loop.rs)
- Open FIFO read-end O_NONBLOCK, integrate into poll() loop
- Parse Stop hook JSON payload (session_id, transcript_path, last_assistant_message)
- Derive transcript path from session_id + cwd slug if transcript_path absent
- Signal event loop exit via channel/flag

Complete when:
- Integration test test_stop_hook_fires passes (mock_claude emits Stop, FIFO received, exit 0)
- test_missing_transcript_path_derived passes (Stop without transcript_path → path derived from session_id)

Reference: docs/plan/plan.md § Phase 6
